items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: they were playing an arrangements of “Stand By Me,” the Ben E. King song.

ctx.x: Was it sort of a funky style brass band or a traditional brass band?

I think it was more traditional, although the next time we heard them, the next night, they were playing an arrangements of “Stand By Me,” the Ben E. King song. But they were wailing. You could hear them for blocks.

I mean it’s not really the song, it’s really in how it’s approached, what they’re doing with it. But yeah we need the brass band sound to continue to evolve, we need everything to continue to evolve. We just need to, as things evolve, we need to remain proud of what’s come before and not feel like we’re doing something bad by continuing to enjoy it and continuing to play it.
